description: Blocks network exfiltration of .env files, SSH/TLS private keys, cloud credentials, and inline API tokens.

rules.name: exfil_env_or_ssh_over_network
rules.description: Blocks curl, wget, nc, scp, or rsync commands transmitting .env, SSH keys, or cloud credentials.
rules.message: Blocked potential credential or .env exfiltration over network command.

rules.name: exfil_inline_api_tokens
rules.description: Blocks network commands embedding raw GitHub, GitLab, OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack, or AWS tokens.
rules.message: Blocked inline API token or cloud key in outbound network command.

rules.name: read_ssh_or_cloud_private_keys
rules.description: Blocks direct file reads of SSH private keys, GPG private keys, and cloud credential stores.
rules.message: Blocked direct read of private cryptographic key or credential store.
